note: Authored NPCs have free-text roles, so each gets a call with its reason. Figures go by rules.eligibility.byRole. Default for anyone not listed: none.

the_kestrel.why: keeps the Roost free by her own ledger; a pass the Crown wants needs a watch, or it is taken

warden_isolde.why: keeper of the Green Accord at Thornwake; the Accord needs wardens to be more than a promise

reed_mother_ossa.why: moral centre of a self-governing town on stilts; skiffs and rope-walks are a militia waiting to be called

warden-coll.why: an Edge District Warden with an office at the Crossing and a council seat: a watch, and the Undercount's natural enemy

adept_sona.why: argues for the Middle Way against both poles, from a school-town of athlete-scholars

master_taro.why: Flesh-Temple master; the temple already sends fighters where a fight must be stopped

dame_iseult_hardline.why: knight-champion of Hardline; forty riders swore to her oath-charge

orrun_shieldbreaker.why: raider-captain of the Longshore reach with a ship and a crew that voted him in

cassa_redsail.why: a pirate out of the Unspooling who takes ships nobody insures

the_high_luminary.why: absolute authority of the Radiant Plateau; one of the two cities that want the Echo Bridge

elder_resonance.why: master of the Harmonic Heights; the other city that wants the Echo Bridge

aelith_first_shape.why: Monarch of the Kept Court; a court with a mason, an ent and courtiers is a seat of power

ysenkar.why: a true dragon of the Unbought Court

rootbound_vaskar.why: Ent hardliner who would seal the wood; the Rootbound are a following, not a lone voice

the_lightless_seraph.why: a fallen Seraph reaching across the world with a nanite intelligence; a host, not a hermit

mediator_corran.why: holds the Marchward neutral by talk; an army would end what he is for

broker_sain.why: sells neutrality from the Quiet House; a house, not a host

sister_vreni.why: runs the Kindly Rest, its terraces and drying lofts

archive_guardian.why: self-appointed keeper of the Lost Archive

deni-cors.why: builder of the south-circuit waystation he runs to

lenten.why: runs the Cogitarium's supply line from Waymarker

brann_tollhand.why: a small crook at the Roost's lower gate: the Undercount's informant there, not a power of his own

greta_waystation.why: keeps the halfway waystation alone; the Tollmen's chain sits above her, and she opposes them
